surveyed.source: OSM node 5653694042 "Teun de Jager" (Jan Bronner, 1958); figure and plinth read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (2017-2020, 8 m away); the facing (250 degrees, +-25), figure height (1.75 m) and block size are visual estimates; the face and coat folds are not legible and are simplified

attribution.title: Teun de Jager (Vondelpark) - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Jan Bronner (1958); figure reconstructed from photographs by Ceescamel
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "2019 Teun de Jager (02).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2019_Teun_de_Jager_(02).jpg); "2019 Teun de Jager (03).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2019_Teun_de_Jager_(03).jpg); "2019 Teun de Jager (04).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2019_Teun_de_Jager_(04).jpg); "2019 Teun de Jager (05).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2019_Teun_de_Jager_(05).jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model.
